svg.title: Six-country study coverage
svg.desc: Europe map identifying Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Poland and Sweden. Numbers 1–6 identify countries, not rank. The study includes 696 General Survey participants, 534 longitudinal participants and 2,111 weekly observations.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth Admin 0 1:50m. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/v5.1.2/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson. g.text: One colour = study coverage. Numbers identify countries, not rank.
